requirements.title: Validate one scenario at a time
requirements.description: ValidateScenario accepts one scenario slug and returns pass/fail, summary, and stable findings without computing fleet graphs or dependency drift.

validation.notes: Use fake descriptor/repo loaders to assert per-scenario filtering and no cross-scenario graph traversal.

requirements.title: Emit stable proto finding taxonomy
requirements.description: Findings include severity, code, location, message, and suggestion for correctness errors, maturity warnings, and advisory info.

validation.notes: Table-drive each planned finding code: cycle, gen_out_of_sync, package_mismatch, stability_dishonest, cross_domain_import, unsupported_annotation, hand_rolled_transport, version_naming, domain_mismatch, missing_health_proto, possibly_unused, REST payload declaration/static consistency, import kind, stability dependency, and shared-type placement.
